neighbours.label: the digits of hexadecimal literals in code (0x01, \xfd)
fire:
if status == 0x02:
    retry()
mask = value & 0x40
data = b'\x7f\xfd\x12\xc8'
if (flags & 0x10) >> 4:
    stop()
PORT_ADDR = 0x3f8
reg = 0x0a
header = '\x89\xfd\x4e\x47'
assert size == 0xe4
quiet:
if status == 2:
    retry()
mask = value & 64
data = b'hello world'
if (flags & 16) >> 4:
    stop()
PORT_ADDR = 1016
reg = 10
header = 'hello there'
assert size == 228
